svg.title: How the repositories fit together
svg.text: VSE JSON files for static tariffs, APIs for dynamic tariffs
Utilities with constant and multilevel tariffs only
Own repo per utility: ekz, bkw, groupe-e
or that maintain their data themselves
The hub repo is the organization site with the own domain,
each own repo a project site under /<slug>/
